## About

Starting as a data analyst and data scientist at startups and growing into an AI data part lead, I have built data-driven decision-making and reproducible analytics and ML pipelines. My work spans user growth analytics, training-data curation (MLOps) for vision models, and hybrid statistical + ML predictive modeling.

[Experience](experience.qmd) · [Projects](projects.qmd)

### Tech Stack
* **Languages & Data:** Python, SQL (DuckDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, BigQuery)
* **Analytics & Visualization:** Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, statistics and time-series analysis, Tableau
* **Growth & Log Analytics:** Firebase, Appsflyer, Amplitude, A/B test design
* **ML & MLOps:** Kubeflow, DVC, MLflow, OpenCV, Librosa
* **Workflow & Infrastructure:** Git, GitHub Actions, Docker, AWS, Quarto

### Education & Certification
* Yonsei University, B.A. in Applied Statistics and Economics
* TensorFlow Developer Professional Certificate
